artifacts.description: Exact loaded _make_it_stand extension binary for this case.

local_metrics.name: projected_target_energy
local_metrics.semantics: Final projected balance-target energy reported by the R10 diagnostics.

local_metrics.name: deformation_energy
local_metrics.semantics: Final unscaled Laplacian shape energy reported by the R10 diagnostics.

local_metrics.name: normalized_rms_displacement
local_metrics.semantics: RMS source-vertex displacement divided by the maximum source bounding-box extent.

local_metrics.name: normalized_maximum_displacement
local_metrics.semantics: Maximum source-vertex displacement divided by the maximum source bounding-box extent.

local_metrics.name: maximum_handle_scale_deviation
local_metrics.semantics: Maximum absolute deviation of a user-handle uniform scale from one.

local_metrics.name: committed_event_count
local_metrics.semantics: Count of committed R10 geometry states, including the initial state.

local_metrics.name: carving_iteration_count
local_metrics.semantics: Count of recorded carving iterations under the modern controller semantics.

local_metrics.name: deformation_iteration_count
local_metrics.semantics: Count of recorded deformation line-search iterations.

local_metrics.name: algorithm_success
local_metrics.semantics: One when the native result classifies the optimization outcome as successful.

local_metrics.name: targets_reached
local_metrics.semantics: One when all declared final balance targets are reached.

local_metrics.name: manufacturing_ready
local_metrics.semantics: One when the sealed manufacturing audit reports ready.

local_metrics.name: final_cavity_volume_fraction
local_metrics.semantics: Final inward cavity volume divided by final outer-envelope volume; reported only for an empty or strictly valid inner boundary.

local_metrics.name: material_mass_change_fraction
local_metrics.semantics: Initial material mass minus final material mass, divided by initial material mass; deformation can make this value negative.

local_metrics.name: measured_minimum_wall_clearance
local_metrics.semantics: Minimum audited outer-to-inner clearance when a cavity exists and the audit completes.
